purpose_context: The doctrine layer predates the DRG and the pack-layout convention that replaced its earlier models. Nothing enforced either, so drift was silent: dead artefacts, unfollowable migration hints, and a deprecated relationship surface that looked authoritative. This mission lands the structural remediation and the test-quality doctrine series that surfaced it.
purpose_tldr: Make the doctrine layer's canonical model enforceable, so drift fails loudly instead of silently.
